hero.name: Rick
hero.title: Frontend Developer
hero.subtitle: Building the future, one component at a time.

about: I'm a frontend developer with over 4 years of experience building web and mobile applications across fintech, media, and gaming industries.

My journey started with optimizing Vue 2 applications for SEO and performance at CMoney, where I first learned how small technical decisions can have a big impact on real users. That curiosity drove me further — at Amber Network, I built SSR platforms with Nuxt 3, real-time features via WebSocket, and animated event pages with GSAP, learning to balance speed, interactivity, and clean code at scale. Most recently at S Ray Technology, I expanded into cross-platform mobile development with React Native, shipped apps to both the App Store and Google Play, and maintained Cocos Creator games — bridging the gap between web and native experiences.

Outside of work, I'm drawn to the intersection of frontend engineering and Web3. This portfolio itself is a reflection of that passion — a cyberpunk-themed Blackjack DApp built with React, Three.js, and Solidity on the Sepolia testnet. I build things because I'm genuinely curious about what's possible on the web.

experience.company: S Ray Technology Ltd (銳光管理顧問有限公司)
description: Built cross-platform mobile applications using React Native, delivering production-ready iOS and Android apps and successfully publishing them to the Apple App Store and Google Play.
Developed the web version of the application using Vue 3, ensuring feature consistency and a responsive user experience across mobile and browser platforms.
Maintained and enhanced existing Cocos Creator v3 games, implementing remote asset management to support cross-version compatibility and minimize redundant deployments.

experience.company: Amber Network (安璞科技資訊股份有限公司)
description: Built responsive SSR websites with Nuxt 3, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for fast performance and clean UI. Used WebSocket for real-time updates and i18n for bilingual support (ZH/EN). Integrated Google Analytics to optimize structure via traffic insights.
Maintained and optimized legacy codebases built with Vue 2 and Sass, ensuring stability and reducing technical debt.
Created visually dynamic event landing pages with Vue 2 and GSAP, enhancing user engagement through rich animations.

experience.company: CMoney Financial Network(CMoney全曜財經資訊股份有限公司)
description: Improved SEO performance of existing Vue 2-based websites by optimizing meta tags, page structure, and crawlability, resulting in higher search rankings and increased organic traffic.
Enhanced performance of Vue 2 applications by refactoring code, optimizing image loading, and managing front-end assets, significantly improving page load speed and user experience.
Managed bar inventory, ordering, and cost control to ensure efficient operations.
Prepared a wide range of classic and signature cocktails, delivering high-quality service and enhancing guest satisfaction in upscale hotel and casino environments.
